products.title: Sofa - Piaf - By Baxter
products.description_html: Socialising is the key word. Piaf is a sofa with a curved design that represents the ideal focus of the living room according to Baxter. A modular and cosy piece that redefines space with extraordinary elegance and generous, reassuring shapes. The model’s originality lies in a series of voluminous modules that can be played with to create compositions characterised by curves, a key element on which to lengthen the seats and give the piece ever new shapes. Surrendering to Piaf’s rounded, smoothed contours means allowing yourself to be enveloped in a comfortable embrace, a sense of protection and softness made irresistible by the leather upholstery.

products.title: Sofa - Anais - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its minimalist, sophisticated design, the Anais armchair and ottoman collection expresses all the discreet, vintage-inspired 1970s elegance typical of Draga&Aurel products. The formal precision of the refined chair, which rests on a solid metal base, is softened by the enveloping, upholstered embrace of the backrest. Featuring a shape distinguished by its austere comfort, Anais invites you to take a break on one of the square or circular seats of the three ottomans, highly versatile elements that can enhance any environment and context. From the living room to the wardrobe and bedroom.

products.title: Bench - Regis - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Regis is the perfect representation of practicality and versatility. Whether used as additional seating or as a footrest, this elegant and functional stool effortlessly transforms into a pouf. Regis adds a touch of elegance to any space, creating a warm and inviting environment for guests to relax at their leisure.

Crafted with a burnished metal base of three polished legs and circular frame, Regis exudes understated sophistication. The seat, custom upholstered in luxurious vegetable-tanned leather or carefully curated textiles by designer Marta Ferri, ensures both comfort and style. Vincent Van Duysen describes Regis as "a timeless piece with enduring appeal," reflecting its ability to transcend trends and complement any interior with grace.

Measuring 48cm in diameter and 45cm in height, Regis blends form and versatility. Its circular yet structured design allows it to seamlessly integrate into various settings, serving as a connecting element between pieces like the Augusto and Lucio sofas from the 2024 collection.

products.title: Armchair - Keren - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Keren is an innovative collection of soft leather armchairs and ottomans designed by the eclectic Christophe Delcourt for Baxter. Inspired by nature’s geometric shapes, Delcourt’s design perfectly interlocks organic and bevelled forms to create a small armchair with a harmonious seat and compact dimensions complemented by a sculptural ottoman. Two furnishing elements that dialogue in a perfect balance, capable of enhancing any room, from the living room to the dining room.

products.title: Ottoman - Istanbul - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The upholstered Istanbul ottomans designed by Paola Navone for Baxter offer a sensory experience of comfort and softness. Perfect in any environment, these upholstered and leather-covered seats not only decorate spaces with the sinuous lines of their design, but also create an extra cosy oasis for relaxing breaks and convivial moments. The versatility of the Istanbul ottomans makes them ideal elements to complete any space and offer a resting experience that is as elegant as it is comfortable.
